The number of Indians declaring an income above ₹1 crore has risen from about 44,000 to more than 3.2 lakh in 12 years. Companies earning ₹50–500 crore in annual profit have more than doubled in a decade. Saurabh Mukherjea of Marcellus Investment Managers explains how local family businesses in towns like Boisar are emerging as India’s new kings and queens.
